name: clipboard
description: Read from or write to the system clipboard.

manual.overview: Use to read or write clipboard content when copying outputs for the user, pasting templates, or bridging between tools and the user's workflow.

examples.description: Read current clipboard to reuse or process copied text
Copy a URL or command for the user to paste elsewhere
Copy a command the user can paste into terminal

tips: Use write after generating content the user likely wants to share
Read before suggesting edits to avoid overwriting unsaved clipboard content
Clipboard is shared across apps; concurrent access may cause race conditions
edge_cases: Writing may fail if another app has exclusive clipboard lock
Binary content (images, files) is not supported—text only
